_what: Everything the Meta upload tools need about this brand: which account they write to, and where this brand's inputs live. Copy this file to brands/<brand>/meta/account.json and fill it in. The tools name no brand — this file is the only place brand context enters (workspace rule 7).
_read_by: meta-upload/brand.py — run `python3 brand.py <brand>` to check it
_ids: Read these off the live account, never guess them. account_id is in the Ads Manager URL (act=...). page_id, pixel_id and instagram_id come off an existing ad in that account.
_campaign: Feeds naming.campaign() -> `MARKET | PRODUCT | FUNNEL | Lane`. Read the convention off the account first; do not invent one. The lane is per-drop (--lane), not here, because a brand runs several and they never blend.
_defaults: Sensible for a direct-response conversions campaign. Change only what this brand actually runs.
_inputs: Paths from the repo root. pictures, copy and pages are required. roster, adsets and offers are optional — the builder says which are missing rather than failing.
_spelling: Only the slugs a plain capitalise gets wrong. Everything else needs no entry.
